title: IEEE 2026 Confirmation: LR + XGBoost Brier ~0.20 — Primary CPU-Actionable SOTA
summary: Comprehensive IEEE 2026 method comparison confirms logistic regression and XGBoost both achieve Brier ~0.20 and AUC 0.75-0.76 on NBA game prediction. Complex sequence models (MC-dropout LSTM) do not automatically outperform classical well-calibrated baselines. This is independent corroboration of the MDPI 2026 finding from fire-85.
